purpose: Existing PCAP data semantics and event evidence; no detection-effect experiment

pcap.sha256_provenance: R27 lab full-member receipt; not an independently published official PCAP SHA

interval.extraction: Whole PCAP, preserving pre-window connection state and post-window completion
interval.cohort: Report crossing-boundary and EOF cases; do not silently cut connections to the four-day window

variant_policy: Paired extraction sensitivity, no arm selected by association count or later model score
not_equivalent: TCP captured payload bytes are not IP bytes
last observed packet is not actual detector receipt
R27 candidate ID is not Zeek UID

time_contract.zeek_reported_end: Zeek ts plus available duration; may exclude trailing non-productive TCP packets/final ACK and is not the captured last-packet time; missing remains unknown
time_contract.replay_export_time: Instrumented Zeek network clock when the connection log is emitted; historical replay time only
time_contract.feedback_scenarios: None executed in this batch; any later assumption must be registered before score/threshold evaluation
time_contract.evaluation_truth: May be adjudicated retrospectively, never silently reused as earlier training/calibration feedback
time_contract.eof_policy: Keep end-of-trace flushing and uncertain termination separate; no claim of genuine online receipt

evidence_contract.normal_multi_connection_actions: Retain all candidate connections; never restrict the cohort to single matches
evidence_contract.normal_download_requirement: Positive business provenance required, not just a filename extension, service port, large size, or lack of attack label

next_decision: Assess usable fields, trace integrity, event support, normal coverage and time assumptions together; no automatic model experiment
